subject.title: fix: scope ACP search path approvals [AI]

question: Should ACP `search` auto-approval fail closed when any protocol path surface, including `toolCall.locations`, points outside the active cwd?
rationale: This is an authorization boundary with compatibility impact: the safe fix changes when existing ACP search calls prompt, while the submitted patch leaves one protocol-backed path surface unguarded.

options.title: Require full path scoping
options.body: Block merge until rawInput, title, and `toolCall.locations` paths all share the same cwd containment rule and focused tests.

options.title: Accept raw/title-only scoping
options.body: Merge the current shape knowing ACP `toolCall.locations` can still carry an unscoped path through search auto-approval.

options.title: Pause for boundary direction
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide the permanent ACP search permission model and user-prompt compatibility tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Require full path scoping
recommendation.body: Block merge until rawInput, title, and `toolCall.locations` paths all share the same cwd containment rule and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: shakkernerd merged the PR that introduced this ACP approval surface and is the clearest available routing owner for the permission-boundary decision.
